full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-watercolor cartoon shows four eccentric women gathered with cats against an almost entirely white background. The open upper half contains generous blank paper, interrupted only by a few stray hair strokes and a narrow vertical line near the right edge. At far left, a tall woman in an olive coat stands with her arms folded and an orange shoulder bag at her hip; oversized round glasses and a pointed nose give her a surprised profile. Near the center, another woman sits with one knee raised, her pale patterned jacket and lavender trousers indicated by thin, irregular washes. Her yellow hair twists into a loose knot, and her glasses turn toward the shorter figure beside her. That figure crouches low in ochre and burnt orange clothing, looking up with wide white eyes while holding a small cat close to her chest. On the right, a tall blond woman leans against the slim vertical edge in a pale yellow top and rolled blue trousers, also folding her arms. A black cat sits upright at the lower left, an orange-and-white cat rests near the central feet, and more tails and paws thread through the loose cluster along the bottom. Fine black pen lines vary between confident contours and scratchy, broken marks, while transparent olive, mustard, lavender, blue and rust washes stop short of filling every form. The lighting is flat and paper bright, with no dramatic cast shadows; a few gray strokes beneath the feet merely anchor the group. The overall composition is playful and airy, balancing a lively band of figures and small animals against broad white space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形钢笔水彩漫画在几乎全白的背景前聚集了四名古怪女子和几只猫。敞开的上半部保留大块空白纸面，只有零散发丝笔划和右缘附近一道细竖线打断它。最左边，一名穿橄榄色外套的高个女子抱臂站立，髋边挂着橘色肩包；夸张的圆眼镜和尖鼻子让她的侧脸显得惊讶。中央附近，另一名女子抬着一只膝盖坐着，淡花纹外套与淡紫裤子由纤细、不规则的水洗色暗示。她的黄发松松挽成发结，眼镜转向身边较矮的人物。那人穿赭黄与焦橙色衣服低蹲，睁大白色眼睛向上看，同时把一只小猫抱近胸口。右边，一名高个金发女子穿浅黄上衣和卷边蓝裤，靠着细窄的竖向边界，同样抱着双臂。黑猫直坐在左下，橘白相间的猫停在中央脚边，更多尾巴与爪子穿行于底部松散聚集的形体中。纤细黑色钢笔线在笃定轮廓与刮擦、断续的痕迹之间变化，透明的橄榄、芥黄、淡紫、蓝与锈色水洗并未填满每个形体。照明平坦，纸面明亮，没有戏剧性投影；脚下几笔灰线仅把群体轻轻固定在地面。整体构图俏皮而透气，以热闹的人物与小动物横带平衡宽阔白地。
style_prompt_en: A lively pen-and-watercolor cartoon treatment leaves broad white paper exposed around loose clusters of forms. Thin black contours stretch into expressive, uneven curves, then break into quick scratch marks or small hatching where a detail needs emphasis. Transparent washes of olive, mustard, rust orange, dusty lavender, and pale blue sit slightly inside or beyond the drawing, allowing pigment and line to retain separate rhythms. Forms are elongated and gently distorted, with rounded accents interrupting narrow verticals. Minimal gray grounding marks establish a shallow space without closing the open background. Illumination stays flat and paper bright, so the eye follows the springy contours and scattered color accents rather than modeled shadow. Dense activity across one band contrasts with generous negative space, creating a witty, spontaneous visual balance.
style_prompt_zh: 活泼的钢笔水彩漫画处理让宽阔白纸露在松散聚集的形体周围。纤细黑轮廓延展成富于表情的不均匀曲线，随后在需要强调的细节处断成快速刮擦线或少量排线。橄榄、芥黄、锈橙、灰紫与浅蓝的透明水洗略微留在勾线内侧或溢出线外，让颜料与线条保持各自的节奏。形体被拉长并轻柔变形，圆润重音打断狭窄的竖向结构。极少灰色落地笔痕建立浅空间，同时不封闭开放背景。照明始终平坦，纸面明亮，视线因而追随有弹性的轮廓和分散色彩重点，而非塑形阴影。一条密集活动带与宽裕留白相对，形成机智而即兴的视觉平衡。
theme_en: Four eccentric women and their cats in a loose ink-and-watercolor character drawing
theme_zh: 松散钢笔水彩人物画中的四名古怪女子与她们的猫
name: Signe Wilkinson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
